import moment from 'moment'
import dayjs from '../src'
import utc from '../src/plugin/utc'
import timezone from '../src/plugin/timezone'
import weekYear from '../src/plugin/weekYear'
import weekOfYear from '../src/plugin/weekOfYear'
import nl from '../src/locale/nl'
dayjs.extend(utc); dayjs.extend(timezone); dayjs.extend(weekYear); dayjs.extend(weekOfYear)
const NY = 'America/New_York'
it('v', () => {
  const ts = 1401624000000
  expect(dayjs.tz(ts, NY).format()).toBe('2014-06-01T08:00:00-04:00')
  expect(dayjs.tz(new Date(ts), NY).format()).toBe('2014-06-01T08:00:00-04:00')
  expect(dayjs.tz(dayjs(ts), NY).format()).toBe('2014-06-01T08:00:00-04:00')
  expect(dayjs('2014-06-01T12:00:00.500Z').tz('America/Los_Angeles').format('Z')).toBe('-07:00')
  expect(dayjs('2014-06-01T12:00:00.500Z').tz('America/Los_Angeles').format()).toBe('2014-06-01T05:00:00-07:00')
  for (let i = 1; i <= 31; i += 1) {
    expect(dayjs(`2018-01-${i}`).locale('nl').format('Do')).toBe(moment(`2018-01-${i}`).locale('nl').format('Do'))
  }
  ;[['2019-01-01', 2018], ['2019-01-04', 2018], ['2019-01-06', 2019], ['2018-12-31', 2019]].forEach(([d, r]) => {
    expect(dayjs(d).locale('en-gb').weekYear()).toBe(r)
    expect(dayjs(d).locale('en-gb').weekYear()).toBe(moment(d).locale('en-gb').weekYear())
  })
})
EOF

arguments.text: Fixed: `d.tz` now routes non-string input (timestamp/Date/Day.js) through `d(input).tz(tz)`, and `proto.tz` rounds the offset diff, preserves ms and uses the offset at the instant. Full suite green.
Fixed in src/plugin/timezone/index.js (rounded/preserved-ms offset in `proto.tz`); `format('Z')` is now a clean offset string.
Fixed src/locale/nl.js ordinal to the Dutch forms (1ste/2de/…/8ste/20ste/…).
Fixed src/plugin/weekYear/index.js: January dates in week >= 52 now report the previous year.
Fixed src/plugin/customParseFormat/index.js: A/a tokens now resolve AM/PM through the locale's `meridiem` function.
Fixed src/plugin/duration/index.js: `milliseconds()` now returns `$ms % 1000` (the ms remainder).
